newsitem.title: GREECE: Greek Progress Fund says 96 net up 24pct.
newsitem.headline: Greek Progress Fund says 96 net up 24pct.

text.p: Closed-end fund Greek Progress said its fiscal 1996 net profit rose 24.6 percent to 1.8 billion drachmas, amounting to earnings per share of 295.2 drachmas.
The fund will propose to its upcoming shareholders meeting a net dividend per share of 200 drachmas, unchanged from a year earlier.
"The fund's performance in the first quarter of this year is better than first quarter 1996 and overall prospects are positive," it said.
Its net asset value per share in March 31 was 3,238 drachmas with the share trading at a discount of 18 percent.
The fund was 70.3 percent invested in equities at the end of the first quarter with unrealised capital gains of 3.0 billion drachmas.
